_comment: RK3566 ground (.199), devourer radio RX. Re-brought-up 2026-08-21 from the Aug-1 kernel-monitor config: that backend was DELETED in Pass 164, so the old config no longer loads at all. 8812CU on USB bus 1-1 (measured with lsusb -t; bus paths shuffle on re-plug, so re-measure — never carry one over). rtl88x2cu must be unloaded before start; S49waybeam-link does it. Spectator with originator 10 keeps the x86 ground (9) authoritative. cache.repair dropped: 192.168.2.247 does not answer. policy.return dropped: §15.2 withholds it from a node with no role:"tx" adapter, so it was inert here.

streams._conceal_comment: §6.3b armed 2026-08-21, after Phase C acceptance was measured ON THIS DECODER (findings 2026-08-21): MPP agrees with ffmpeg to 89 dB over two CTU rows on a repaired stream, disagrees at 39.4 dB over the whole frame on a gap AU, and reports errinfo 0 discard 0 on BOTH — so waybeam-hub's errinfo||discard branch, and the IDR requester it gates, never fire for this fault class. 'off' restores pre-§6.3b behaviour bit-for-bit. freeze_frame on: the hub's default presents errinfo frames, so freezing is cheaper than dropping.
